hotel_name: Hotel Divine Residency By Jmd Group

positive_snippets: I had stayed in this property for two days and being a tour guide I found this hotel to be neat and clean. The behaviour of the staff Mr Akram is really good and he is a polite person. I will recommend this budget friendly hotel to everyone.

Loved the service!! Rooms were clean, food was delicious and on time, staffs were sweet and helpful. I would like to recommend Hotel Divine Residency to people seeking good hospitality. Special thanks to Hassan sir ,🙏
negative_snippets:
The hotel is so poor
They do not have running water since last night
Do not even have toilet rolls
The manager doesn’t even know what a toilet roll is
People are freely smoking and roaming inside hotel
Please do not book if you’re coming with family
Or you dont want to waste your money

The hotel staff is very rude and they do not honour their bookings and timings as well. On top of that the front desk guy is stubborn and very unprofessional. Don't recommend this place for family at all and even for a friends trip pay a little more somewhere else but you will he happy for sure.
